title: Hard-sphere fluctuations on the regular Boltzmann lifespan
main_claim: Take a deterministic grand-canonical hard-sphere gas in R^3 in the Boltzmann-Grad scaling mu=eps^{-2}, on any interval [0,T] where the Boltzmann solution keeps uniform Gaussian velocity decay. Its empirical fluctuation field, centered by the exact microscopic expectation, converges in finite-dimensional laws to the Gaussian solution of the linear fluctuating Boltzmann equation. The noise covariance is (1/2) int B f f_* DeltaPhi DeltaPsi and the initial covariance is int f0 phi psi.
coverage:
I read all of Section 1 (statement), Section 3 (the DHM imports and the definition of the pasted dynamics), Section 5 (the cutoff probability O(eps^{1+eta})), Section 7 (covariance identification and the cumulant CLT) and Section 8 (exact-centering transfer and the proof of the theorem). From Section 2 I read the initial Mayer/Penrose bounds and the centering shift; from Section 6 I read the statement, the merger coordinates, the factorials lemma and the summability lemma. I did not read Section 4 (marked component expansion) or the later parts of Section 6 (no-extra-contact, spatial traces, tree completeness, last-contact splitting).

Checks that held up:
- Transfer: the Holder exponent condition p>(1+eta)/eta gives eps^{-1+(1+eta)(1-1/p)} -> 0.
- Cumulants: the factorial-to-ordinary identity gives kappa_2/mu = c1(y^2)+mu c2(y⊗y) and higher cumulants O(mu^{1-k/2}); the characteristic-function truncation bound 2|u|^{2n}sigma^{2n}/(2^n n!) is right.
- Covariance: the source coefficient in the G evolution, Delta(PR)=R DeltaP + P DeltaR + DeltaP DeltaR, leaves (1/2)int BFF_* DeltaPhi DeltaPsi. The mark is invariant, so the restricted drift equals A_t and the source equals C_t. The backward variance formula is consistent with the target.
- Initial ensemble: the 27-ball packing bound and q<=27n are correct, as are the -4pi/3 f0 rho0 centering shift and mu||c_{2,0}||_1=O(eps).
- Cutoff: the free strongly-close pair gives mu eps^{9/10+12/5}=eps^{13/10}. The aiming equation (t2-t1)(z-v)=q2(t1)-q1(t1)+O(eps) and the three tube/preimage cases give eps^{1/20}. All the hierarchy inequalities in the amplified-cut lemma give delta g - 2 s4 >= 6/5. I verified the degree-count identity s2+p33=r+s4+p44-1 algebraically.
- Summation bounds: the ellipsoid volume (AM-GM on det(I+P AA^T) with HS^2<=3q, ball volume) is correct. In the time-order bound, linear extensions times the product of relative speeds is at most (2qP)^{q/2}, using an antichain energy bound. The Stirling/convexity steps give (C tau sqrt L)^q.
- Merger scaling: mu^{m-h} eps^{2(m-c-p)} eps^{3p} = mu^{c-h} eps^p, and the pair-flux bound n^{3/2} sqrt P is correct.

What I took on trust: the imported Deng-Hani-Ma propositions (cutting algorithms 15.x, local estimates 9.x, Section 14 tree comparison).
sibling_notes: On the family-364 board there was one sibling, the Boltzmann-Grad paper for stable radial potentials (rank 72), reported as no_gap_found with one minor bookkeeping slip. It uses a different (potential) framework and shares no specific lemma with this paper, so it did not affect this audit.
